purpose: Small structural time-series proxy for VBN model and interface experiments.

protocol.assignment: Sort file names within each torque level, then assign the first 60% to train, next 20% to validation, and final 20% to test.

limitations: The subset is small and comes from one controlled measurement sequence.
Adjacent files within a torque condition are not independent structures.
The labels are bolt-torque proxies, not building damage or collapse labels.
The sensor is contact acoustic emission, not an MPU6050 accelerometer.
